desired.meaning: proposal, not obtained data; group allocation may prevent exact case ratios; counts are not population weights

group_before_split.allocation: after admission and closure freeze, SHA-256 UTF-8(protocol version + NUL + seed + NUL + group_id); interpret first 8 bytes as unsigned big-endian modulo 10000: <6000 train, <8000 dev, otherwise test. Every member inherits its group assignment across tracks. Pin full algorithm/seed/input membership/ledger/protocol hashes before running; do not reroll for balance
group_before_split.balance: 60/20/20 is by group allocation, approximate by cases; 120/40/40 strata are acquisition targets. Report achieved strata by split, group and case denominators, deficits, missingness and null weights. Never silently move groups or drop failures to meet a target
group_before_split.closure: build an undirected linkage graph over original source references across all tracks; union every substantiated task/root/repeat/shared-content edge, transitively. Check exact content duplicates and investigate likely semantic duplicates. Missing context, unresolved alias/link, independent label or exposure quarantines the affected connected component and potentially linked unresolved members before allocation
group_before_split.evidence: every edge carries type, original endpoint refs/hashes, rationale, adjudicator and attestation; every no-link/not_applicable decision has source evidence; freeze membership and edge ledger hashes
group_before_split.future_group_id: SHA-256 of canonical JSON object {members: sorted original identity objects, linkage_ledger_sha256: frozen ledger digest}, using hash_contract.canonical_rows. Each original identity has system, independently attested source namespace, table and original source_id; sort by canonical identity bytes. Namespace must identify the original DB/repository instance, never an invented ID. Unknown namespace/membership withholds the group. These future group IDs are not assigned in candidate v1.
group_before_split.identity: evidence-resolved original task aliases, root incidents, repeats/retries, shared replay/source content and cross-track reuse; record placeholders and textual similarity never establish independent groups
group_before_split.implementation: protocol only; no runnable split or admission is implemented in candidate v1
group_before_split.limits: group membership evidence reduces known leakage; it cannot prove unknown links absent. No leakage guarantee or accepted/balanced dataset is claimed. Zero current sealed assignments is an evidence hold, not a split-quality result
group_before_split.sealed_test: separate steward custody/access ledger; freeze before any tuning, hide test inputs/answers from developers/optimizers, never tune on reported test needs; exposed seed/dev queries cannot become untouched test needs. If test exposure or linkage changes, invalidate affected claims and version the cohort; no silent reassignment

hash_contract.candidate_content: canonical row hash after removing only content_sha256
hash_contract.canonical_rows: SHA-256 UTF-8 json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False), no newline
hash_contract.manifest: input-lock pins originals and source contracts; rows pin protocol and lock; artifacts/manifest pins schema, producer and generated outputs; no self-hash cycle
hash_contract.source_summary: analysis-v1 convention: SHA-256 UTF-8 original summary, null as empty bytes; summary hash is not replay-input hash

manual_admission: A designated dataset steward freezes a consented sampling frame/query/time, source custody and authorized redactions. Obtain representative episodes and separately observed healthy controls including successful operations; error absence is not a control. Preserve unselected records and unknown sampling weights.

An expert inspects the authorized original source outside this repo, supplies minimal replay input/context refs and hashes, intent/difficulty/segment/track/criticality/stratum plus task/version and prompt/model/config/decoding/seed/environment/order pins. Never copy raw restricted summaries. Root cause is evidence-based, not the axial code.

Steward records task aliases, root incident, retry/repeat and duplicate relationships with original IDs, exact evidence refs/hashes and rationale; not_applicable needs affirmative evidence (e.g. healthy control root incident). Unknown absence is not no linkage. Hold unresolved members and their possibly linked groups.

Experts annotate independently before seeing model/user/post-review answers. Use existing authorized journal with separate validity and disposition, provenance.kind/exposure/attestation_ref/original_ref/protocol_version, annotation_schema/original_event_id and append-only supersedes. A new independent annotation never relabels assisted history. Do not read or rewrite real expert answers/journals in this task.

Require unexposed attestation and scoped author authorization, versioned expected-output/rubric and original event/evidence refs before accepting an independent label. Conflicts/unclear evidence remain quarantined or abstained; no majority/agreement-only promotion.

Run the predeclared QC design separately for validity and disposition: at least 20 gold decisions and 20 repeat decisions per field; gold and repeat shares each >=10%; separate accuracy/consistency floors >=0.90. Repeat presentations are not independent cases. Gold reference decisions need authorized expert evidence first; no QC reference set exists here. Agreement around 0.80 is diagnostic, never truth or an admission threshold by itself.

An authorized human records an append-only admission decision with reviewer, time, protocol hash, evidence hashes, reasons, original source/event IDs and supersedes. This directory is a reproducible candidate projection, never a second label authority. Publish a new dataset release for admissions; do not hand-edit generated candidates.

Before sealing, the steward independently audits linkage closure, cross-track shared sources, exposure and per-class heldout denominators. Collect more data for insufficient cells; hold affected quality claims instead of fabricating balance. Current independent gold remains needs_labels and calibration unavailable.
